name: avantgate
description: Zero-infrastructure, in-process AI Application Firewall (AI-WAF) & privacy control plane for TypeScript: real-time prompt guardrails, zero-egress PII redaction, agent tool isolation, anti-IDOR defense, pre-flight token budgets, and multi-model failover.
author: Antigravity & LexTalk Team

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/finance/index.ts src/agent/index.ts src/workflow/index.ts src/client/index.ts --format cjs --format esm --clean && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.test: tsx tests/avantgate.test.ts && tsx tests/preflight-budget.test.ts && tsx tests/financial-normalizer.test.ts && tsx tests/prompt-builder.test.ts && tsx tests/pii-extended.test.ts && npm run test:agent && npm run test:workflow && npm run test:client
scripts.test:agent: tsx tests/agent/step-runner.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/isolated-tool.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/dto-pattern.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-patterns.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/storage-adapters.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-aliasing.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-chaining.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-storage.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/telemetry-exporter.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/platform-adapter.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-governance.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-impact.test.ts
